treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Estonia and the Republic of Austria for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2001)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 4. | Austria | 15.12.1999 | 05.04.2001 | 17.09.2002 ( est/eng ) | 12.11.2002 | 01.01.2003 | 01.01.2022
source_title: EE-AT Convention 2001, RT II 2002, 29, 134 (Riigi Teataja, est/eng)

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties in all other cases.
a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties paid for the use of industrial, commercial or scientific equipment;

ppt.quote: Synthesised text (fin.ee): "The following paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI applies and supersedes the provisions of this Convention: ... a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude ... that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ..." ; fin.ee: "Estonia submitted its first notification under Article 35 (7) (b) ... on 25 November 2021 and the provisions of the MLI enter into effect to the 7 tax treaties listed in the notification from 1 January 2022." (Austria listed, 25.11.2021)

notes: Royalty 5% tier applies only to equipment-rental royalties (not a holding tier). Interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)): government/central bank/wholly-owned financial institution or government-guaranteed loans; credit-sale interest on merchandise/equipment between unrelated enterprises. No protocol; no MFN clause noted by Estonian MoF. MLI: Estonia applies only Arts 6, 7, 9(4)-type, 5, 16, 17 (no Art. 8 holding period).
